chunks: Ibn al-Abbas from Ibn Shajarah from Ibrahim ibn Abi Raja who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Good character increases livelihood.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of good character in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that good character (husn al-khuluq) directly increases one's livelihood (al-zar'), a concept deeply rooted in Shia tradition where moral excellence is seen as a divine catalyst for material and spiritual sustenance. This hadith, found in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, underscores the practical implication that ethical conduct in social interactions is not merely virtuous but also a means of securing Allah's blessings in worldly affairs. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the unity of spiritual piety and social ethics as pathways to divine favor.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: Ibn ʿAbbās narrated from Ibn Shajarah, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Rajāʾ who said, “
Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) said, ‘[Espousing] a good character increases [one’s] livelihood.’”
